results.title: How to Find a Location with Ria Money Transfer - The Ria Blog
results.content:
## How to find a Ria Money Transfer with our store locator

You can locate any of our Ria stores using our store locator in Ria’s website. Our team is diligently updating our opening hours and new locations on the platform.

Beyond our stores, you can also find us at many different Ria Money Transfer partner locations around the world including post offices, retail chains, convenience stores, banks, and grocery stores. We’re always adding new partner locations to our roster, so keep an eye out for our logo!

## What kind of services does your Ria Money Transfer location offer?

Depending on the country, our services may include any of the following:

 International money transfers
 Check cashing
 Bill payment
 Money orders
 Cash pickup
 Mobile top-up
 Donations [...] ## How to find a location on the Ria website

1. Visit the Find A Location tool on the Ria Money Transfer website.

1. Use a city, state, or postal code to refine your search.

1. From there, you can click on a location and even map directions if you would like.

You’ll find that we have partnerships around the world that make sending and picking up money transfers safe, simple, and convenient. These include PayNearMe and 7-Eleven, available in the US so that you can pay for your transfers with cash, OXXO, and many, many more.

If you’re ready to get started, get our app today!

## How to find a Ria Money Transfer with our store locator [...] We recommend calling ahead to double-check service availability. Also, please keep in mind that opening hours may differ from one location to another, so be sure to check the specific opening times for your location of choice. As a plus, our store tellers can also inform you of the current rates for money transfers to your destination country.

## COVID-19 FAQs

To ensure your safety, we’re following recommended area guidelines and precautions at our stores. We kindly ask that you be mindful of each stores’ specific procedures.

You can find an extensive list of FAQs in our COVID-19 Resource Center.

And there you have it! We hope to see you at one of our stores soon.
